title: 131 Marketing Skills You Didn't Know Claude Could Do
description:
This is the complete go-to-market stack for Claude Code: 131 plug-and-play skills and plugins that cover your entire marketing workflow. SEO, ads, ICP research, brand voice, logo and image generation, content creation, social media, and outreach, all inside Claude Code.

People pay hundreds of dollars for setups like this. These skills are free and ready to drop into Claude Code today. Whether you're a beginner or already running Claude Code daily, this is the fastest way to turn it into a full marketing team.

If you want the stack, the link is below.
